name: SIB-200: Simple Inclusive Benchmark for 200+ Languages
description: SIB-200 is a massively multilingual topic classification benchmark covering 205 languages and dialects, derived from the Flores-200 translation benchmark. It contains 204,181 sentences annotated across 7 semantic categories: science/technology, travel, politics, sports, health, entertainment, and business. Designed to evaluate zero-shot and few-shot cross-lingual generalization on high, medium, and extremely low-resource languages across diverse geographic regions.
